intro: A look at how we help businesses get better results from WordPress. Replace these examples with your own real projects.

cases.title: New business website that generates enquiries
cases.challenge: The company had an outdated website that was slow, hard to use on phones and did not bring in enquiries.
cases.solution: We designed a new mobile-first WordPress website with clear service pages, a quick contact form and improved page speed.

cases.title: WooCommerce store rebuilt for faster checkout
cases.challenge: Customers were leaving during checkout, and the store was slow because of too many plugins.
cases.solution: We removed unneeded plugins, optimized images, simplified the checkout steps and set up caching.

cta.title: Want results like these?
cta.text: Share your goals with us and we will plan the right solution.
